data.name: Valkyrie
data.description: Hermes Linear channel plugin: one Hermes session per delegated ticket.
data.content:
Hermes channel plugin for Linear's agent API. Third-party `kind: platform` plugin, no Hermes core changes.

## Decided

* Python plugin, full channel adapter: Linear events become gateway messages; the gateway owns sessions
* One Linear OAuth app per Hermes profile (`actor=app`); tokens via client credentials (auth-code flow is the fallback)
* Webhooks only, exposed via Tailscale Funnel; no polling
* One shared listener: `/linear/<profile>/webhook`
* Delegated ticket = one Hermes session for the whole ticket: every agent thread, plain human comments (wake the agent), edits (context only)
* Non-delegated ticket: @mention = thread-scoped one-off session. @mention on a delegated ticket joins the ticket session
* Re-delegation resumes the ticket session unless Done/Canceled
* Context-only digest: Issues, Comments, Issue attachments, Projects, Project updates (not label-definition events)
* Access: `LINEAR_ALLOWED_USERS` (UUID / email / `*`) or `LINEAR_ALLOW_ALL_USERS`; default deny; denied users excluded from context
* Visibility: every tool call as an `action`, commentary as `thought`, heartbeat on long turns, todo → Linear plan
* Approvals/clarify as `elicitation` + `select`; approvers follow `approvals.approvers`
* Build order: probe → core delegated loop → the rest. M1 exit = dogfood (retire the `linear-orion` route)
